assessments.reasoning: Paragraph 2 gives two positions for the trailing marker and permits a line without a leading marker in the ordinary case. Paragraph 3 makes that marker mandatory and adjacent to the token remainder in the split-token case.

limitations: The statement describes the dated J3/24-007 working text. Compiler behavior and final ISO conformance have separate scopes.
